technical.summary: IBM shows long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200, Ichimoku cloud) but lacks near-term momentum confirmation; multiple oversold indicators without reversal signals and bearish MACD suggest weakness persists despite technical setup.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 3 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (31/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed with junior members and no clear conviction; lack of recent news sentiment limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (371.2) combined with earnings binary event in 3 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; yield curve normal but macro backdrop highly unfavourable for positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (110.35) offers contrarian entry in fear-driven market (VIX crisis), and oversold conditions (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R) theoretically precede reversals.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 3 days with critical volatility risk, bearish MACD with negative histogram, price below both EMA-9 and EMA-21, no momentum confirmation on oversold indicators (no OBV rise, no stochastic bullish cross), and zero fundamental/insider support make this a high-risk trap setup.
